name: ixi_brain_mri
title: IXI: ~600 healthy-subject brain MRIs (T1, T2, PD, MRA) from three London hospitals
description: The Information eXtraction from Images dataset: T1, T2, PD-weighted and MR angiography volumes of nearly 600 healthy subjects acquired at Guy's, Hammersmith and the Institute of Psychiatry (1.5 T and 3 T). One tar per modality on the Imperial College server, read subject by subject with HTTP Range (indexing a tar walks its ~580 headers once, a few minutes). Subject ids such as IXI002-Guys-0828 join the modalities into one sample. Demographics are in IXI.xls on the website.
